text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono has the day off today,
and I'm
working in my office. Or I should
be, but I keep
dozing off.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...All done! ♪ Mm... It looks sooo
tasty! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A mouth-watering aroma tickles my nose
and
wakes me up. Its comforting scent
reminds me of
a storybook scene of a
happy family sitting
together.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello, Trainer! ☆ You were out like a
light.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm here with a late-night pick-me-up for
you! It's
chanko! Thanks for working so
hard for my sake!
choice_data_list: なんでアケボノがここに……？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I do indeed see chanko right in front of
me, but
as grateful as I am for her
thoughtfulness, I can't
help but wonder...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Well, I wanted you to eat your fill
without
worrying about anything, but
since it's so late...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I thought you wouldn't want to have
anything
that's too rich and heavy, so I
made two kinds of
chanko!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You can choose between a meaty miso
chanko
full of dreams and a lighter
chanko with a salt
broth that's full of
veggies!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Which one sounds good to you? I'll
warm up the
other for the girls at the
dorm, so choose
whichever you like.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The salted chanko would definitely be
nourishing.
The miso chanko might sit a
bit more heavily, but
it would be more
energizing. I think I'll pick...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! ♪ That's a great choice! You've
gotta fuel
up after such long hours!
choice_data_list: 夢いっぱい味噌ちゃんこ
お野菜メインの塩ちゃんこ

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I put almost two kilograms of meat in it,
but I can
add more if it's not enough! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead and eat your fill so we can
both train at
our best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono's love comes through
with every
bite, and we finish the entire
pot together!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All right, sure thing! Veggies are
definitely what
you need right now,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I made this while channeling aaall my
hopes that
it'll be nice and nourishing,
so I'm sure this'll perk
you right up! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
We should eat it before it gets cold!
Give me a
moment to ladle it out for us!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
These mushrooms are actually really
rare. An old
lady shared them with me
after I carried her out
of the forest after
she got lost, and...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I listen to her talk, the chanko sends
warmth
and energy throughout my body.
Tomorrow is
going to be a great day—I
just know it.
